system.description:
Move an object with a Strange Check (CR set by its size); Doom +1 on success. Or, as an Attack Action against a Large or smaller enemy, make an Opposed Strange Check vs its Grit: on a win, move or throw it 30 ft in any direction, dealing falling damage (30 ft = 3 Blunt). Doom +2 on success against an enemy.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.63

automation.label: Move an object (CR by its size)
Move a targeted enemy 30 ft (opposed vs its Grit)
automation.onSuccess: Move the enemy up to 30 ft in any direction. Doom +2.

automation.label: Throw a targeted enemy 30 ft (opposed vs its Grit)
automation.onSuccess: Throw the enemy 30 ft; it takes 3 Blunt falling damage. Doom +2.

automation.note: Using it on an enemy (Large or smaller only) takes your Attack Action instead of an Interact Action; the Director rolls the enemy's Grit and sets the CR so you need more successes.
